gate: A narrowing happens here, the way attention finds one thing and burns into it until the thing gives up its detail. Not surface attention, not the busy kind, the kind that quiets the rest of the room. The energy is to stay with a small piece of something long enough that it actually yields. The misread is that focus, in this code, is constant, a steady beam you can aim wherever the day asks. It is not. The code moves in waves. It picks its object, and outside that object the attention scatters. People carrying this gate are often told they are inconsistent, easily distracted, unable to multitask. The honest reading is the opposite. This is built for one thing at a time, deeply, and the cost of forcing it wider is that nothing gets the depth it needed.
centre_field: The Sacral is the body's motor, the engine of sustainable life-force that powers everything a person actually does. That is the placement worth dwelling on. Focus, as a concept, is cheap. Focus that lasts long enough to finish anything requires fuel, and the fuel is the wave of yes from the gut, not a decision made in the head. The Sacral does not run on willpower. It runs on response, on the yes that lights up when something is actually right to engage. When focus is wired into this engine, attention is not a discipline imposed on the mind, it is the natural settling of the whole body onto something it has said yes to. Forcing focus on what the gut has not agreed to is what burns this code out. The body simply will not concentrate on a no.
channel: Incomplete on its own. This code reaches down toward the gate of stillness, and the two together form the channel of concentration. The reach matters. Focus by itself is volatile, it darts, it cannot hold position long enough to go deep into a single thing. What this code lacks alone is ground. The stillness it reaches for is what fixes attention in place, the quiet weight in the body that lets the narrowing actually become depth instead of restlessness. Alone, the focus is fidgety, picking up and putting down. Joined, it becomes the kind of attention that sits with one thing for hours and emerges with something the busier mind would never have found. Stress from below, focus above, and the channel between them is how that pressure stops being agitation and becomes work.
